title: Course Payment

sections.heading: Advance Booking Fee
paragraphs: To secure a place in the course, participants are required to pay a non-refundable advance booking fee. The advance booking fee includes a 3% surcharge that covers currency conversion and bank fees.

subsections.heading: Booking confirmation letter
paragraphs: An official booking confirmation letter will be sent shortly after the successful deposit of the advance amount.

sections.heading: Course Balance Fee
paragraphs: The remaining balance of the course fee can be paid upon arrival at the school by credit card, debit card, or cash. For participants choosing to pay the balance through online banking platforms, cards, or third-party apps, please note that an additional 3% surcharge will apply. This surcharge covers transaction fees imposed by the payment provider, including foreign transaction and currency conversion charges.

sections.heading: Course Balance Fee In Cash
paragraphs: Cash is still the most widely used payment method in Bali, Indonesia, and most foreign currencies are accepted, including INR, JPY, USD, EUR, GBP, AUD, CAD, KRW, CNY, and many more.
